memory_update.text: Primary US-listed direct equipment candidates for semiconductor_equipment_process_tools: ASML, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, ONTO. TER is a strong adjacent test candidate for a follow-up pass if final test/HBM test is prioritized.

The node should be tracked as a cluster, not a single EUV chokepoint: lithography, deposition, etch, clean, process control, metrology, inspection, advanced-packaging tooling, hybrid bonding, and semiconductor test all show plausible AI/HBM/leading-edge exposure.

Need next-pass coverage for non-US or OTC leaders and suppliers: Tokyo Electron, Advantest, ASM International, BE Semiconductor, Disco, Lasertec, Screen, Entegris, MKS Instruments, and advanced-packaging/test socket/probe-card suppliers.

Need market-pricing check: compare 2026 revenue growth expectations, backlog/order trends, China revenue exposure, export-control sensitivity, and whether advanced-packaging/HBM demand is already fully priced into each candidate.

summary: Expanded the US-listed public-company universe for the semiconductor process-tools node. The strongest direct exposures are lithography, wafer-fab equipment, deposition/etch/clean, inspection/metrology/process control, advanced-packaging process control, and semiconductor test. The five candidates below are research candidates only, not buy/sell recommendations. Initial evidence suggests the node is broader than EUV: AI-driven leading-edge logic, HBM, advanced packaging, and yield/throughput pressure map to multiple tool categories.
